scenarios.scenario_abstract: After the wedding party selects one army-toned suit, [X] compares its regular and evening versions by whether the chosen trousers continue the jacket surface or introduce a formal side treatment, then checks the result with the group's shoes, accessories, and photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 婚礼一行人选定同一种军绿色调西装后，[X]会通过比较常规版与晚礼服版，判断所选西裤应延续夹克的面料与纹理，还是加入正式的侧边处理，并结合全组的鞋履、配饰和合影效果复核结果。
examples: keeping the trouser surface uninterrupted when the group chooses regular suits
using a narrow repeated side detail only when the wedding formality supports it
checking that the treatment reads consistently across the whole groomsman group

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While creating an outdoor luncheon dress theme for twenty-five golf friends, [X] decides whether skirts, skorts, shorts, or jeans should repeat the group's shared motif or remain understated beneath more decorative tops, while preserving grass-friendly comfort and a coherent group photograph.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为二十五位高尔夫球友设计户外午宴着装主题时，[X]会决定半身裙、裙裤、短裤或牛仔裤应承担共同的视觉线索，还是在更具装饰性的上装下保持克制，同时兼顾草地活动舒适度与整齐的集体合影。
examples: giving guests one repeat or motif family without requiring the same garment
keeping the lower half quiet when a patterned blouse or graphic top already carries the theme
checking whether a bolder lower treatment remains legible rather than chaotic in group photos

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While assembling one Tracer cosplay, [X] modifies a selected pair of athletic leggings so the lower half is recognizable from the character reference, comparing stenciled paint with sewn panels and checking sharpness, placement, movement, and durability beside the rest of the costume.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 制作一套猎空角色扮演服时，[X]会改造一条已经选定的运动紧身裤，使下半身能够对应角色参考图，并比较模板喷绘与缝制拼片在轮廓锐度、位置、活动性及与整套服装搭配时的耐久表现。
examples: using crisp directional marks when reference accuracy matters
building the design from separate color zones instead of one repeated print
testing whether painted or sewn details distort during convention movement

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While laying out a medieval half-elf bard costume from toe to head, [X] decides how stockings, leggings, skirts, and armored lower layers can share decorative language without becoming visually crowded or disrupting the order in which the costume must be put on.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 按照从脚到头的顺序规划中世纪半精灵吟游诗人服装时，[X]会判断长袜、紧身裤、裙装与下半身护甲如何共享装饰语言，又不至于显得拥挤或打乱整套服装的穿戴顺序。
examples: repeating a floral or musical motif across only selected lower layers
using geometric or linear details to connect fabric layers with armor
letting texture carry the visual interest when several other layers are already ornate

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After sharing photographs of two previously worn outfits, [X] reviews how the visible lower garment affects the continuous body line, the balance of added layers, and the placement of brighter accents before deciding which pattern treatment to retain in the next version of each look.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 分享两套真实穿过的造型照片后，[X]会复盘画面中可见下装如何影响身体线条的连续性、叠穿层次的平衡以及亮色点缀的位置，再决定下一版造型应保留哪种图案处理。
examples: using an uninterrupted surface when the wearer wants one long visual line
checking whether a repeated motif adds interest without widening the photographed lower half
moving the visual emphasis between the lower garment, jacket, and accessories

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping for a thirteen-year-old's summer-camp sleepwear, [X] moves from an initially considered military-inspired set to the teenager's stated preference for plain dark multipacks, checking size charts, cabin expectations, availability, and whether the final choice is something the teenager will actually pack and wear.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为十三岁孩子购买夏令营睡衣时，[X]会从最初考虑的军事风套装转向孩子明确表示愿意穿的纯色深色多件装，并核对尺码表、营地住宿要求、购买渠道，以及最终选择是否真的会被孩子带去并穿着。
examples: treating the teenager's rejection of the first visual direction as purchase evidence
showing printed and quiet options before ordering instead of assuming age determines taste
using willingness to pack the set for a shared cabin as the final acceptance check

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a five-day trip through Rome, Florence, and Venice, [X] limits the suitcase to two long lower garments and one warm-weather alternative, then plans how each surface can repeat across sightseeing, church visits, train transfers, and a nicer dinner without breaking the small mix-and-match wardrobe.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在罗马、佛罗伦萨和威尼斯的五日行程中，[X]会把行李限制为两件长下装和一件暖天备选，并规划每种表面如何在观光、教堂参访、火车换乘及稍正式的晚餐中重复使用，而不破坏小型混搭衣橱。
examples: using a quiet surface for the pair that must coordinate with the most tops
allowing one repeat or motif to act as the capsule's statement lower garment
checking whether scale and color distribution still coordinate after several outfit repeats

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B stadium concert, [X] balances a possible graphic artist top with cargos, biker shorts, relaxed jeans, or a matching set, deciding where the outfit's visual activity should sit while preserving comfort on stairs, hard seats, sustained dancing, secure storage, and photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加 R&B 体育场演唱会时，[X]会在可能选择的歌手图案上衣与工装裤、骑行短裤、宽松牛仔裤或成套服装之间分配视觉重心，同时兼顾上下台阶、硬座椅、长时间跳舞、安全收纳和拍照。
examples: keeping the lower half visually quiet beneath an artist graphic
using a coordinated set whose zones remain clear while moving
checking whether a bolder lower motif still works with the jacket tied at the waist

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool, cloudy day, [X] builds around an existing thin black bomber and compares jeans with chinos by whether their surfaces keep the layered outfit coherent, introduce useful contrast, and still work with sturdy shoes on damp ground.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在凉爽多云的一天，[X]会围绕已有的轻薄黑色飞行夹克搭配牛仔裤或休闲裤，比较下装表面能否维持叠穿造型的完整性、提供恰当对比，并在地面潮湿时仍与耐穿鞋履协调。
examples: using one uninterrupted lower surface for a restrained layered look
introducing a repeat, panel division, or tactile effect without competing with the bomber
judging the full outfit in flat outdoor light rather than from a swatch alone

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual afternoon campus reunion, [X] builds from a familiar pair of jeans, a sweater, and classic clogs, then checks how the jeans' surface affects a polished-but-approachable impression without making the no-dress-code outfit look either careless or overdone.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加校园里的下午同学聚会时，[X]会以计划穿的一条熟悉牛仔裤、毛衣和经典洞洞鞋为基础，检查牛仔裤表面如何影响既得体又亲切的整体印象，避免在没有着装要求的场合显得过于随便或用力过猛。
examples: using the familiar pair as a baseline before considering a more noticeable surface
checking whether a repeated or pictured treatment looks intentional with the simple sweater
rejecting any direction that overwhelms the relaxed no-dress-code reunion
